cartes: Tony Blair is Prime Minister (New Labour); devolution referendums
Plaid Cymru (Welsh separatist party) is founded
Government of Wales Act: creation of the National Assembly for Wales in Cardiff
Welsh Assembly: Labour 30 seats, Plaid Cymru 13, Conservatives 16
Rhun ap Iorwerth (Plaid Cymru) becomes First Minister of Wales
Census: Scottish Gaelic spoken by 1% of the population
Scotland Act: creation of the Scottish Parliament in Edinburgh (Holyrood)
Scottish independence referendum: 55.3% vote no, turnout 86.6%
Scottish elections: SNP wins 64 seats out of 129
Brexit referendum: 62% of Scots vote to remain in the EU
John Swinney becomes First Minister of Scotland (SNP)
